name: Vintage Charcoal Roasted Milk Tea Pot
marketing_tip: Embrace the rustic charm of traditional hearth brewing with our 2026 edition roasted tea pot.
body: Designed for the 'stove-side tea' trend, this ceramic pot is perfect for roasting tea leaves or preparing authentic milk tea over charcoal. Its heat-resistant construction and traditional aesthetic bring a touch of nostalgia to any gathering.
